description_id: Pack integrasi Xendit — BYO credential, 4 operasi siap pakai: invoice.create / invoice.get / refund.create / balance.get. Plaintext API key disimpan terenkripsi (AES-256-GCM) di integration_credentials table; setiap operasi dipanggil via /integration-proxy-xendit Edge Function dengan X-CID + HMAC bearer auth. Pelanggan bisa revoke kapan saja. Setiap call dicatat di audit_log (sanitized, no PII). Bahasa error mapping (invalid_api_key / insufficient_balance / rate_limited / dst.) sudah jadi.
description_en: Xendit integration pack — BYO credential, 4 operations ready: invoice.create / invoice.get / refund.create / balance.get. Plaintext API key encrypted (AES-256-GCM) in integration_credentials table; every operation goes through /integration-proxy-xendit Edge Function with X-CID + HMAC bearer auth. Customer can revoke anytime. Every call audit-logged (PII-sanitized). Bahasa error mapping ready.

skills.description_id: Buat invoice baru di akun Xendit pelanggan. Required: external_id, amount, description. Returns invoice_url 24-jam-expiry default.
skills.description_en: Create new invoice in customer's Xendit account. Required: external_id, amount, description. Returns 24h-expiry invoice_url by default.

skills.description_id: Cek status invoice by ID. Enum: PENDING / PAID / SETTLED / EXPIRED dengan mapping Bahasa.
skills.description_en: Get invoice status by ID. Enum: PENDING / PAID / SETTLED / EXPIRED with Bahasa mapping.

skills.description_id: Refund invoice (partial atau full). Catatan: channel cash (Indomaret / Alfamart) tidak support refund otomatis.
skills.description_en: Refund an invoice (partial or full). Note: cash channels (Indomaret / Alfamart) do not support automated refunds.

skills.description_id: Cek saldo Xendit pelanggan. Default account_type = CASH.
skills.description_en: Get customer's Xendit balance. Default account_type = CASH.
